title: Cthulhu
statementMd:
...Once upon a time a man came to the sea. The sea was stormy and dark. The man started to call for the little mermaid to appear but alas, he only woke up Cthulhu...

Whereas on the other end of the world Pentagon is actively collecting information trying to predict the monster's behavior and preparing the secret super weapon. Due to high seismic activity and poor weather conditions the satellites haven't yet been able to make clear shots of the monster. The analysis of the first shot resulted in an undirected graph with $*n*$ vertices and $*m*$ edges. Now the world's best minds are about to determine whether this graph can be regarded as Cthulhu or not.

To add simplicity, let's suppose that Cthulhu looks from the space like some spherical body with tentacles attached to it. Formally, we shall regard as Cthulhu such an undirected graph that can be represented as a set of three or more rooted trees, whose roots are connected by a simple cycle.

It is guaranteed that the graph contains no multiple edges and self-loops.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61f746e2fd33d321a4cc0fdce9a73a82096068e7.png)

## Input

The first line contains two integers — the number of vertices $*n*$ and the number of edges $*m*$ of the graph ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤$![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6fbba87a6e66854e5728f67cc384b75c4bcf131.png)).

Each of the following $*m*$ lines contains a pair of integers $*x*$ and $*y*$, that show that an edge exists between vertices $*x*$ and $*y*$ ($1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*, *x* ≠ *y*$). For each pair of vertices there will be at most one edge between them, no edge connects a vertex to itself.

## Output

Print "`NO`", if the graph is not Cthulhu and "`FHTAGN!`" if it is.

## Note

Let us denote as a simple cycle a set of $*v*$ vertices that can be numbered so that the edges will only exist between vertices number $1$ and $2$, $2$ and $3$, ..., $*v* - 1$ and $*v*$, $*v*$ and $1$.

A tree is a connected undirected graph consisting of $*n*$ vertices and $*n* - 1$ edges ($*n* > 0$).

A rooted tree is a tree where one vertex is selected to be the root.
statementZhMd:
……很久以前，一个男人来到了海边。海面风暴肆虐，昏暗无光。男人开始呼唤小美人鱼出现，但遗憾的是，他只唤醒了克苏鲁……

而在世界的另一端，五角大楼正在积极收集信息，试图预测这个怪物的行为，并准备秘密超级武器。由于强烈的地震活动和恶劣的天气条件，卫星还无法拍摄到清晰的怪物图像。对第一张照片的分析得到了一个包含 $*n*$ 个顶点和 $*m*$ 条边的无向图。现在，世界上最聪明的人们正准备判断这个图能否被视为克苏鲁。

为简单起见，我们假设从太空看，克苏鲁就像一个附着着触手的球形物体。形式化地说，如果一个无向图可以表示为三个或更多棵有根树的集合，并且这些树的根通过一个简单环相连，那么我们就认为它是克苏鲁。

保证图中不存在重边和自环。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61f746e2fd33d321a4cc0fdce9a73a82096068e7.png)

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数——图的顶点数 $*n*$ 和边数 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤$![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6fbba87a6e66854e5728f67cc384b75c4bcf131.png)）。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行，每行包含一对整数 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$，表示顶点 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 之间存在一条边（$1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*$，$*x* ≠ *y*$）。对于每一对顶点，它们之间至多有一条边，且没有边连接顶点自身。

## 输出格式

如果图不是克苏鲁，输出 `NO`；如果是克苏鲁，输出 `FHTAGN!`。

## 说明

我们将简单环定义为这样一个包含 $*v*$ 个顶点的集合：这些顶点可以被编号，使得边只存在于编号为 1 和 2、2 和 3、……、$*v* - 1$ 和 $*v*$、$*v*$ 和 1 的顶点之间。

树是一种包含 $*n*$ 个顶点和 $*n* - 1$ 条边的连通无向图（$*n* > 0$）。

有根树是指选定了其中一个顶点作为根的树。
